notes.title: Sign up for the playtest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934256/d4d1a518f8aafdd1e0ab742ccbd3764773c536d4.png

About the playtest
We're getting close to releasing a demo, but first we would appreciate help from players on any potential bugs missed during closed testing. The playtest will be a short experience (~30min) to ensure we're focusing on the most important aspects for player experience.

Sign Up!
Simply click on the Request Access button on the steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358660/ReAwaken/

Dates
We'll start giving player's access on August 7th and close the playtest August 27th.

Content
- 1 area with various levels having a Good and Evil version
- 24 Upgrades & Downgrades to choose from during your runs
- 15 Attacks & Special abilities
- 6 Permanent upgrades to unlock and equip
- 9 Enemies
- 1 Shadowy boss battle

Thank you
With your feedback we know the game is going to awaken to it's fullest potential! We appreciate any support as we prepare to make the game as engaging and enjoyable as possible!
